name: @scramjet/runner-bun
description: Bun sequence runtime wrapper for Scramjet Transform Hub runner isolation.

scripts.prebuild:docker: if [ "${SCRAMJET_DOCKER_RUNNER_STAGED:-}" != "1" ]; then cd ../.. && scripts/build-all.js --no-install --link-packages -d packages/runner -o ./dist/docker-runner/ --ts-config tsconfig.build.json; fi
scripts.build:docker: docker build -t scramjetorg/runner-bun:$(git rev-parse HEAD) -t scramjetorg/runner-bun:dev -f Dockerfile ../../

author: Scramjet <opensource@scramjet.org>
